newsitem.title: USA: U.S. EPA to hold hearing on RFG proposal April 18.
newsitem.headline: U.S. EPA to hold hearing on RFG proposal April 18.

text.p: The Environmental Protection Agency said Friday it would hold a hearing April 18 in Washington on its plan to let states join the U.S. reformulated gasoline program.
RFG is currently required in the 10 areas of the country which have the dirtiest air.

In its proposal issued last month, the agency sought comments on whether states that wanted to opt into the program should have to give at least one year's notice before requiring RFG to be sold in their areas.
The agency also proposed changing the lead time for withdrawals from the RFG program to become effective.
